## Website architecture overview

The portfolio is a lightweight single-page-style site with a fixed desktop shell in [index.html](index.html). The main content area is swapped dynamically by the router, while the header, sidebar, and footer remain persistent.

### Core structure
- Shell container: [index.html](index.html)
  - Header
  - Sidebar
  - Editor/main content area
  - Footer
- Page content is loaded from [src/pages/home.html](src/pages/home.html), [src/pages/about.html](src/pages/about.html), and [src/pages/404.html](src/pages/404.html)
- Styling is assembled from [src/style/main.css](src/style/main.css)
- Page rendering is controlled by [src/js/main.js](src/js/main.js), [src/js/router.js](src/js/router.js), [src/js/navigation.js](src/js/navigation.js), and [src/js/pages.js](src/js/pages.js)

---

## 1) Home page structure

### Shell from [index.html](index.html)
The page is built around a main wrapper:

- `.main-parent`
  - `.header`
  - `.sidebar`
  - `.editor`
    - `.main-content`
  - `.footer`

This creates a desktop-style IDE-like layout with a top bar, left navigation panel, main content panel, and bottom footer.

### Page content from [src/pages/home.html](src/pages/home.html)
The home page content is structured as a vertical landing experience:

- `.home-content`
  - `.home-hero`
    - `.slogan`
    - `.home-title`
      - `.grtng-layout`
        - `.greeting.selamat`
        - `.greeting.datang`
      - `.subtitle`
    - `.cta-container`
      - `.cta-btn`
  - `.about-web`
    - `.about-section`
      - `.digital-garden`
      - `.sub-heading-garden`
      - `.description-garden`
      - `.cta-container`
  - `.closing`
    - `.hubungi-saya`
    - `.description-garden`
    - `.cta-container`

### Class naming conventions
The project uses a custom, flat naming pattern rather than strict BEM.

Examples:
- `.home-content`
- `.home-hero`
- `.about-web`
- `.cta-container`
- `.digital-garden`

Pattern characteristics:
- Mostly lowercase, kebab-case
- Descriptive, component/section-based names
- Some combined classes such as `.greeting.selamat` and `.greeting.datang`
- No formal BEM prefixes like `.block__element--modifier`

---

## 2) CSS architecture

### Global import structure
The main stylesheet in [src/style/main.css](src/style/main.css) imports:

- reset styles
- design tokens
- typography
- component styles
- layout styles
- animations
- page-specific styles

### Design token system
The design tokens are defined in [src/style/base/variables.css](src/style/base/variables.css).

#### Colors
- Canvas/background:
  - `--canvas-color`: warm cream
  - `--primary-bg-color`: pale yellow
  - `--secondary-bg-color`: muted tan

- Borders:
  - `--primary-border-color`
  - `--secondary-border-color`

- Text:
  - `--primary-text-color`
  - `--secondary-text-color`
  - `--tertiary-text-color`

- Headings:
  - `--primary-heading-color`
  - `--secondary-heading-color`
  - `--tertiary-heading-color`

- Social/icon accent:
  - `--primary-social-color`

- Extra palette:
  - `--red`
  - `--purple`
  - `--strong-purple`
  - `--aqua`
  - `--strong-aqua`
  - `--blue`
  - `--strong-blue`

#### Typography tokens
Defined in [src/style/base/typography.css](src/style/base/typography.css):
- `--heading-font`
- `--navbar-font`
- `--profile-name-font`
- `--profile-bio-font`
- `--explorer-font`
- `--footer-font`
- `--editor-content-font`

#### Spacing patterns
There are no spacing tokens defined. Spacing is mostly hard-coded using values like:
- `45px`
- `80px`
- `15px`
- `20px`
- `10rem`
- `1rem`

This makes the system feel more “hand-authored” than token-driven.

### Layout patterns
The core layout uses CSS Grid in [src/style/layout.css](src/style/layout.css):

- `.main-parent`
  - grid with:
    - 2 columns: sidebar + editor
    - 3 rows: header + content + footer
- `.header` uses flex
- `.sidebar` uses flex column
- `.editor` uses full-height container
- `.main-content` uses overflow-y auto with hidden scrollbar

### Component styles
The component files are:
- [src/style/components/header.css](src/style/components/header.css)
- [src/style/components/sidebar.css](src/style/components/sidebar.css)
- [src/style/components/footer.css](src/style/components/footer.css)

Current patterns:
- Header: simple flex row with icon and text
- Sidebar: vertical profile area + nav list + folder dropdown
- Footer: row of social icons and metadata

The following component files are present but currently empty:
- [src/style/components/button.css](src/style/components/button.css)
- [src/style/components/editor.css](src/style/components/editor.css)
- [src/style/components/tab-bar.css](src/style/components/tab-bar.css)

### Page-specific styling
The home page styles are defined in [src/style/pages-style/home-style.css](src/style/pages-style/home-style.css). They create:
- full-page vertical landing sections
- large typographic hero titles
- CTA button styling
- section spacing and alignment

### Animation patterns
Animation is mostly handled in [src/style/animation/bg-animation.css](src/style/animation/bg-animation.css) and [src/js/animation.js](src/js/animation.js).

Patterns used:
- Grid glow effect using CSS background gradients
- Cursor-aware glow using a custom `--x` and `--y` CSS variable
- Hover transition on buttons with `transform: scale(1.07)`
- Smooth scrolling behavior

### Responsive breakpoints
There are no active responsive breakpoints in the current CSS. The file [src/style/base/media.css](src/style/base/media.css) is empty, so the site is currently designed as a desktop-first layout with no media-query-based adaptation yet.

---

## 3) JavaScript architecture

### Main initialization
[src/js/main.js](src/js/main.js) initializes three things:
- `initGlow()`
- `initNavigation()`
- `handleLocationChange()`

### Routing mechanism
[src/js/pages.js](src/js/pages.js) defines the route table:

- `/` → home
- `/about` → about
- `/experience` → experience
- `/404` → 404 fallback

### Router behavior
[src/js/router.js](src/js/router.js) does the following:
- Looks up the requested route
- Fetches the page HTML from the route file
- Inserts it into `#main-content`
- Falls back to a 404 page if the route is invalid or the file is missing

### Navigation behavior
[src/js/navigation.js](src/js/navigation.js) handles:
- click events on elements with `data-page`
- SPA navigation via `navigate()`
- anchor links like `#about-web` by scrolling smoothly to the target section
- the folder dropdown toggle for the portfolio submenu

---

## 4) About page status

The about page exists at [src/pages/about.html](src/pages/about.html), but it is currently minimal.

Current content:
- a main wrapper `.about-me`
- a `.hero-section`
- a `.profile-picture` placeholder
- a hero heading saying “haii... nama saya kurniawan”

The stylesheet for it, [src/style/pages-style/about-style.css](src/style/pages-style/about-style.css), is currently empty.

---

## 5) Typography hierarchy

The site uses a mono-space visual language with strong editorial emphasis.

### Typography scale from home page
- Large hero title:
  - `.greeting.selamat` → `4.9rem`
  - `.greeting.datang` → `6.9rem`
- Subtitle → `2rem`
- Section heading → `6rem`
- Supporting text → `.9rem` to `1.7rem`

### Font families
- `jetbrains mono`
- `ibmplex mono`

These are defined in [src/style/base/typography.css](src/style/base/typography.css).

---

    --secondary-text-color: #d79921;
    --tertiary-text-color:#7c6f64;

    --primary-heading-color: #d65d0e;
    --secondary-heading-color: #fe8019;
    --tertiary-heading-color: #98971a;


    --primary-social-color: #83a598;

    /* other color */
    --red: #cc241d;
    --purple: #b16286;
    --strong-purple:#8f3f71;
    --aqua:#689d6a;
    --strong-aqua:#427b58;
    --blue:#458588;
    --strong-blue:#076678;
    
}

```css
.main-parent {
    /* max-height: 90vh; */
    width: min(100%, 1440px);
    height: min(100vw, 700px);
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 365px 1fr;
    grid-template-rows: 60px 1fr 60px;


    margin: 0 auto;
    box-shadow: 15px 10px 30px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.329);

    /* overflow-y: auto; */

}

.header {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    grid-column: 1 / 3;
    background-color: var(--secondary-bg-color);
}

.sidebar {
    background-color: var(--secondary-bg-color);
    border-right: 1px var(--primary-border-color) solid;

}

.editor {
    height: 100%;
    background-color: var(--primary-bg-color);
    min-height: 0;

}

.footer {
    grid-column: 1 / 3;
    background-color: var(--secondary-bg-color);

}

.main-content {
    overflow-y: auto;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    height: 100%;
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
}
```

---

## Bottom line

This codebase is a handcrafted, desktop-inspired personal website with:
- a custom mono-space visual identity
- a fixed IDE-like shell
- a simple client-side router
- mostly custom CSS classes
- strong use of flex/grid layout
- a cursor-reactive “grid glow” animation
- a home page that serves as the main reference pattern for future pages

If you want, I can next turn this into a concise implementation plan for extending the about page or refactoring the styles into a more scalable structure.
